quote: Once you mastered the basics, go ahead and explore and take like a buffet, a little bit of this, a little bit of that, and put it on your plate of trading tools.

text: Use a small amount of money or a demo trading account when learning to avoid wasting hard-earned assets.
quote: Please, in the beginning, when you're learning and you don't know what you're doing, use a small amount of money or a demo trading account. Don't waste your hard-earned assets learning.

text: Take your time to learn and avoid revenge trading or gambling with real money.
quote: Please take your time because as I've already gone over in the psychology video, you might have like a green month or two months and then something flips in your psychology and in one week of revenge trading or gambling, you give back everything you made in in a few months.

text: Explore new tools and strategies but build on the foundation of the basics.
quote: Understand that you need to take those things and if they apply to you, add that on top of what you already are doing. This way you're not flip-flopping around trying to be like I'm only going to use Ichimoku. I'm only going to use Orderflow. I'm only going to use Marcus Ciper. I'm only going to do this to say okay I have a good foundation. I understand the essential things. And now if I come across something new, I will take from that if I feel it will help me and I'll add that on top of what I already know instead of trying to completely change your philosophy or your style.
